scientific_integrity: Proof from conditional independent column-degree bins, binomial occupancy and Fourier anti-concentration. Finite exact and seeded checks are supplementary, not an independent proof of asymptotics. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Fixed Bernoulli density strictly between zero and one; asymptotic probability tending to one, not a finite-n identity. The graded modal depth statement assumes two named reflexive S5 equivalence relations and unrestricted finite counting thresholds. An antecedent in random bipartite color refinement remains possible.
title: Two graded rounds identify every world in a densely random epistemic grid
